The reference shows field-level charcoal rot (yellowing/dying plants). The test image is a close-up of stems with the dense black microsclerotia speckling that is the definitive diagnostic feature of Charcoal Rot — tiny black dots scattered across gray/tan dried stem tissue, exactly as described for *Macrophomina phaseolina*.
